_comment: TIER 1 — universal fast gate: one file for all stacks (py/node/go/php/deno). Auto-detects via hashFiles, caches, parallel jobs (secrets + lint + tests + audit), graceful-skip when stack absent. No docker — docker stays Tier 3. Blocking on high vulns only; full denylist in Tier 3.
name: github-fast-checks
description: TIER 1 universal: secrets (gitleaks+actionlint) + lint (ruff/eslint/tsc/gofmt/php -l/deno lint) + tests (pytest/vitest/go test/phpunit/deno test) + quick-audit (pip-audit/npm audit/govulncheck/composer/deno) — all hashFiles-gated, cached, parallel. No profile fragmentation.

variables.name: shellcheck_version
variables.description: Pinned shellcheck — actionlint auto-lints run: scripts when on PATH

variables.name: ruff_version
variables.description: Pinned standalone ruff release (cached tarball, no pip install)

variables.name: prod_branches
variables.description: Comma-separated production-level branch names excluded from Tier 1 push triggers (branch-level map: T1=dev/feature, T2=staging push, T3=prod push/tags)

variables.name: staging_branch
variables.description: Staging-level branch name — also excluded from Tier 1 pushes (strict one-tier-per-level)

notes: Single source of truth for Tier 1. Consumed by github-ci-security-python/node/generic via uses: [github-fast-checks]. Inline diff-gating: each consumer job runs pinned dorny/paths-filter (v3 commit 0e4a8c6effa4802afeda77dc8d303f8176d7dfad) as its first step, guarded to push/pull_request only — workflow_dispatch and merge_group always full-run; no cross-job needs so all runners boot in parallel. Stack filters defined once (jinja STACK_FILTERS) and rendered byte-identical into all three steps — add a stack in ONE place. Actionlint runs with shellcheck on PATH → embedded run: scripts get linted at PR time. pytest falls back to the full suite ONLY on rc=5 (everything deselected by 'not slow'); real failures propagate once. Caches: gitleaks/actionlint/shellcheck/ruff tarballs, node_modules, .eslintcache + *.tsbuildinfo, govulncheck binary, .venv-fast (exact key). Kill switches: vars.FASTCHECK_NO_TESTS / FASTCHECK_NO_AUDIT = 'true'.
